outcomeNote: Mishna with two parallel cases and no named disputants

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ זֶה בָּא בְּחָבִיתוֹ שֶׁל יַיִן וְזֶה בָּא בְּכַדּוֹ שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ, נִסְדְּקָה חָבִית שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ, וְשָׁפַךְ זֶה אֶת יֵינוֹ וְהִצִּיל אֶת הַדְּבַשׁ לְתוֹכוֹ –
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In a situation where «this» individual «came with his barrel of wine, and that» individual «came with his jug of honey,» if «the barrel of honey cracked and this» first individual «poured» out «his wine and salvaged the» other’s «honey,» which is worth more than the wine, by collecting it «into» his wine barrel,

segments.he: אֵין לוֹ אֶלָּא שְׂכָרוֹ. וְאִם אָמַר: ״אַצִּיל אֶת שֶׁלְּךָ, וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן לִי דְּמֵי שֶׁלִּי״ – חַיָּיב לִיתֵּן לוֹ.
segments.en: the owner of the wine «has» the right to collect «only his wage,» i.e., compensation for the effort he put into salvaging the honey. He is not, however, entitled to compensation for the wine itself. «But if» the owner of the wine «said: I will salvage your» honey «and you will pay me the value of my» wine, the owner of the honey is «obligated to pay him» compensation for the wine.

segments.he: שָׁטַף נַחַל חֲמוֹרוֹ וַחֲמוֹר חֲבֵירוֹ, שֶׁלּוֹ יָפֶה מָנֶה וְשֶׁל חֲבֵירוֹ מָאתַיִם, וְהִנִּיחַ זֶה אֶת שֶׁלּוֹ וְהִצִּיל אֶת שֶׁל חֲבֵירוֹ – אֵין לוֹ אֶלָּא שְׂכָרוֹ. וְאִם אָמַר לוֹ: ״אֲנִי אַצִּיל אֶת שֶׁלְּךָ, וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן לִי אֶת שֶׁלִּי״ – חַיָּיב לִיתֵּן לוֹ.
segments.en: Similarly, if «a river washed away his donkey and the donkey of another,» and «his» donkey was «worth one hundred dinars and» the donkey «of the other» was «worth two hundred, and» the individual with the less valuable donkey «abandoned his» donkey «and» instead «salvaged» the donkey «of the other, he has» the right to collect «only his wage,» i.e., compensation for the effort he put into salvaging his fellow’s donkey. «But if he said to» the owner of the more valuable donkey: «I will salvage your» donkey «and you will pay me the» monetary value «of mine» in exchange, the owner of the more valuable donkey is «obligated to pay» the rescuer compensation for his donkey.

moves.summary: wine poured out to save honey: only a wage
with a stipulation he is paid for his wine
donkey abandoned to save a more valuable donkey: only a wage
with a stipulation he is paid for his donkey

positions.claim: the rescuer receives only his wage unless he stipulated payment for his loss, in which case he is paid
